_conventions.chapter_purpose_heading: ## บทนี้ใช้ทำอะไร (introduction and glossary: ## ส่วนนี้ใช้ทำอะไร)
_conventions.build_markers_for_typesetter: purpose: ['บทนี้ใช้ทำอะไร', 'ส่วนนี้ใช้ทำอะไร', 'What this is for']; tip: ['เคล็ดลับ:', 'Tip:']; important: ['สำคัญ:', 'Important:']; legend: ['ในภาพหน้าจอ:', 'In the screenshot:']; chapter: 'บทที่'; contents: 'สารบัญ'; figure: 'ภาพ'
_conventions.ui_labels: Keep the English on-screen label in bold (screenshots are in English), then a short Thai explanation in parentheses the first time in each section, e.g. **Save** (บันทึก). Where the Thai CRM has an official label (packages/core/src/i18n/th), that label is used as the explanation, so a reader who switches the CRM to ไทย sees the same words. Later mentions in the same section: bold English only.
_conventions.quoted_screen_messages: Keep the English message in quotes, then (หมายถึง: Thai meaning). Short ones may be explained in the sentence instead.
_conventions.numbers: Western digits; amounts as AED 3,000; percentages as 85%; times as 02:00; chapter references as (บทที่ 9).
_conventions.image_alt_text: Translated into Thai; image path kept exactly.
_conventions.names_kept: Spa names (Serenity Spa & Wellness), people (Layla, Nok), plan names (Standard, Premium), URLs, emails, codes (YJVAC, RAMADAN20, ABCD-EFGH), keyboard keys (Ctrl K, Enter, Esc) and the ไทย / EN switch stay as written.
_conventions.register: Polite, plain Thai for spa owners and managers; address the reader as คุณ; no ครับ/ค่ะ endings; short sentences, one idea each.
_conventions.plan_vs_package: The Thai CRM uses แพ็กเกจ for both the subscription plan and prepaid packages. In this manual: subscription plan = แผน / แผนการใช้งาน (always with Standard or Premium); prepaid client package = แพ็กเกจ / แพ็กเกจเหมาจ่าย. UI labels such as Compare plans keep the official explanation (เปรียบเทียบแพ็กเกจ).
_conventions.chapter_titles_note: Use chapter_titles for every H1 (# n. title) and for cross-references, so the contents table in 00-introduction.md matches the chapters.
_conventions.ui_label_source: Official Thai UI labels come from packages/core/src/i18n/th/*.ts (read-only). An en->th lookup table built from them is at manuals/tools-th/uimap.tsv (key, English, Thai).
_conventions.non_ui_bold: Bold lead-ins that are not on-screen labels (e.g. 'To sell:', 'Every plan includes:', the four golden rules) are translated into Thai bold.
_conventions.nested_parentheses: Avoid nested brackets. Inside an existing parenthesis write (**Label** หมายถึง คำแปล). For labels that already contain brackets, e.g. **Amount (AED)**, explain without inner brackets: (จำนวนเงินเป็น AED).
_conventions.numeric_labels: Labels that are only numbers or durations are explained once together: **7 days**, **30 days**, **90 days** (7, 30 หรือ 90 วัน).
_conventions.heading_refs: A cross-reference to another heading uses the Thai heading text in bold, e.g. ดูหัวข้อ **ชำระใบแจ้งหนี้** (check.py flags it as a missing label; expected).
_conventions.example_inputs: Example text the owner types (tone, rules, ideas, notes) stays in English in quotes with a short Thai meaning in parentheses, because the screenshots show English.
_conventions.home_screen: Home screen = หน้าจอหลัก everywhere in prose. หน้าจอโฮม appears only inside the gloss of the iPhone label **Add to Home Screen** (เพิ่มไปยังหน้าจอโฮม), because that is the wording of iOS in Thai.
_conventions.chat_spelling: Prose uses แชต (Royal Institute spelling). แชท appears only inside glosses of official UI labels that spell it so, e.g. **Chat** (แชท), **New chat** (แชทใหม่).
